We got the following feedback:

Entire Graph v0.6.0 skips two valid PostgreSQL migrations with E_PARSE_ERROR around GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY and River CHECK constraints. Both pass Atlas validation and full replay against PostgreSQL 18.

Please improve PostgreSQL parser support. These false positives exclude entire migration files from the code index.
I’ll trace how SQL parse errors exclude files, reproduce the PostgreSQL syntax failures, and check the fix against the existing parser tests.

The current parser has a PostgreSQL compatibility layer. Its generated-column rule appears to miss `BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY`, and CHECK handling needs investigation around named constraints. I’ll add regressions that verify the migrations’ symbols remain indexed, as well as checking that parse errors disappear.
